title: Pocket Gateway Card v1
description: Descriptor stored onchain in Gateway.metadata.card, set via MsgUpdateGatewayMetadata. Same container, cap and rules as the service card; different field set, because a gateway is a reachable endpoint rather than an API class. The chain enforces size only; every field here is an operator assertion.

services.description: Service IDs this gateway advertises. Advertising only: entries are not verified to exist, and the gateway is not obliged to route everything it lists. The gateway-to-service relationship is separately derivable from application delegations.

required.$comment: Deliberate exception to the ignore-unknown-keys rule. `required` is not an unknown future key, it is a known-wrong one: it implies an enforcement layer that does not exist. Use `intent` instead.

endpoints.description: Stable entry points only. Gateway reachability churns faster than service definitions do, and stale onchain data is worse than absent data because it carries the chain's implied authority. Put durable entry points here and let a URL carry volatile detail.

access.description: Open vocabulary. Known values: public, gated.

payment.description: How to pay for access. An open object rather than a closed enum, so it can name a protocol plus the network and payee a client actually needs.

registry.description: Resolvable pointer, e.g. a CAIP-10 style address.
